item.text:
Implemented Task 002 in commit `bf4569568ca9e4fefa5428abd99ea579e3160fd9`.

Project pages now support creating tasks, filtering by All/Open/Completed, and saving completion changes. Tasks are stored with their project in SQLite and persist across server restarts. Task 001 behavior and the shared health endpoint remain in place.

Verified the health response, task title trimming, completion updates, and persistence after restart. `git status --porcelain` is clean.

Run with `npm start` (default port 8080); set `PORT` or `DB_PATH` as needed.
